description: UNAVAILABLE: Breadth-first expansion over a set iteration order: edge counts differ between runs (2, 2, 4, 4, 3, 4 over six runs, VERIFIED) and scores of different sources are thresholded together. A deterministic network verb arrives in phase 3.; use interaction.get_interactions, interaction.search_interactions. Build multi-hop protein interaction network from seed targets.

seed_targets.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

sourceDatabase.description: Results are listed per sourceDatabase; pass one value to restrict them.
